sentences.ar: يوم الأحد، البلد كلها كانت بالكنيسة.
sentences.en: On Sunday, the whole town was at church.
They were holding a funeral for the three boys.

sentences.ar: الناس صاروا يتذكروا أشياء حلوة عنهم.
sentences.en: People began remembering good things about them.

sentences.ar: اللي كانوا يشتكوا منهم صاروا يبكوا.
sentences.en: Those who used to complain about them were weeping.

sentences.ar: صار صراخ وضحك وبكا بنفس الوقت.
sentences.en: There was shouting and laughing and crying at once.
